name: fli
description: TypeScript port of the fli library: programmatic access to Google Flights data through direct API interaction.

scripts.test: bun test tests/models tests/core tests/search tests/integration
scripts.test:watch: bun test --watch tests/models tests/core tests/search tests/integration
scripts.test:coverage: bun test --coverage tests/models tests/core tests/search tests/integration
scripts.test:ci: bun test --coverage --coverage-reporter=text --coverage-reporter=lcov --reporter=junit --reporter-outfile=./junit.xml tests/models tests/core tests/search tests/integration
scripts.ci: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test

author: Punit Arani <punitsai36@gmail.com>
